architecture.intervention: "Use a large language model (e.g., ChatGPT-4) to generate alternative Tesla engine design concepts by feeding it technical abstracts or descriptions of current engine and known frontier technologies from other fields, prompting it to propose modifications for efficiency and speed."
architecture.expected_effect: "Production of a broader set of design variations, increasing likelihood of discovering efficiency/speed improvements from cross-domain ideas."
architecture.falsification_test: "Compare the number of unique, feasible efficiency/speed improvement concepts generated by the LLM-assisted process versus a baseline engineering brainstorming session; if the LLM does not produce a statistically significant increase in novel, implementable concepts, the mechanism fails."
